source: Approved TST-106 and actual user deterministic-workflow/backup-lineage clarification.

cases.title: Actual non-code worker reaches genuine review wait.
Verified opaque review permits Core completion and confirmed Done.
Omitted mechanical calls are chosen by saved-state loop.
Wrong-order, wrong-file and foreign scope cannot grant an effect.
Concurrent run claim admits one owner.
Restart after durable result does not repeat execution.
Lost startup reply reconciles owner or remains uncertain.
Lost executor reply never repeats uncertain physical work.
Human hold, reassignment or scope revision fences continuation.
Missing port and unknown repository impact block explicitly.
Required semantic review cannot be replaced by a passed flag.
Same-task amendment and partial work retain provenance.
Superseded or integrated backups are not current work union.
Finite step/deadline boundary returns a durable checkpoint.
Store/result corruption and stale versions refuse.

host_cases.scenario: Model omits every next mechanical step; controller still chooses the permitted required sequence.
Model requests a wrong file, reordered effect or invented success; trusted plan and current facts refuse it.

constraints: No private evaluator imports or expected dataset answers.
Core remains sole policy and status owner.
